messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI — Rosie sent a resignation. Last day Fri Apr 16. Need COBRA/benefits, exit interview, asset return, and SSO deprovision. @Rosie Tran can you confirm whether you’ll elect COBRA and the shipping address for your laptop? cc @Jared (IT) @Emma (HR)

Rosie Tran: Thanks — confirmation: last day Apr 16 (end of day). I'll elect COBRA; please send the packet to rosie.tran+exit@example.com. Laptop (MacBook Pro, asset 1209) will be shipped back on Mon Apr 19. Also expecting PTO payout — can you confirm timeline?

Emma (HR): Got it. I’ll kick off the exit interview scheduling. COBRA packet link: https://redwood.example/cobra — benefits will terminate 2026-04-30. COBRA election window: 60 days (deadline 2026-06-29). Final paycheck (including pro-rated PTO) will be processed on next payroll cutoff (two weeks) — expect by 2026-04-30. :white_check_mark:

Jared (IT): Filed IT ticket and set tentative deprovision window.
Jared (IT): Plan: revoke SSO and AWS console access 1 business day after last day (2026-04-17) at 17:00 PDT. Service tokens/artifacts will be rotated immediately. Shipping label: @Rosie Tran check your inbox for UPS label from it-returns@redwood.example

Alex (Eng): Quick note — can you transfer ownership of these repos and dashboards before EOD Apr 16? list:
- repo: infra/feature-x
- dashboard: onboarding-metrics
If you want, we can add @Alex (Eng) as temporary admin until deprovision.

Rosie Tran: I'll start a handoff doc in Notion and add owners. Adding laptop serial and asset tag to the retour form now.

Maya (People Ops): Checklist summary:
1) HR: COBRA packet + exit interview (Emma)
2) IT: return label + asset deprovision (Jared)
3) Manager/Eng: repo/dashboard transfer (Alex)
4) Payroll: final pay + PTO (Emma)
Please reply here once each item is done.

deprovision-bot: Ticket created IT-4821 for user rosie.tran. UPS label sent to rosie.tran+exit@example.com. Scheduled SSO disable 2026-04-17T17:00:00-07:00.

Jared (IT): one more q — does Rosie have VPN tokens or personal keys on laptop that require revocation? @Rosie Tran

Rosie Tran: I rotated my personal SSH keys last week; I do have a YubiKey registered for 2FA. I'll drop it in the return package as instructed.

Emma (HR): Noted re YubiKey — add to return checklist. I'll send the exit interview slot options today.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll mark thread as the single source for status updates. :sparkles:
